entry.title: New: Bill 34 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — FC: Withdrawn by introducer - 4/1/2025
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 19, ARTICLES 1 AND 7, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO THE AFFORDABLE RENTAL HOUSING REAL PROPERTY TAX CLASSIFICATION

Repeals the definitions of “affordable rental housing” and “affordable rental rate,” and amends the requirements of eligibility for the affordable rental housing class.

Latest action: FC: Withdrawn by introducer - 4/1/2025
